summary: Separate work status from review status
description: Add task lifecycle semantics so completed work is not treated as accepted work. Model work_status separately from review_status and make needs_fix a first-class path back to the owner.
acceptance: Task state model distinguishes work_status values such as pending/in_progress/completed from review_status values such as none/review/needs_fix/approved.
A completed task cannot become approved without an explicit review/approval transition or documented skip policy.
needs_fix returns work to the owner with required comment/evidence and does not erase review history.
Regression coverage proves completed-without-review cannot be reported as approved.
